articles.highlight: 一辆公交车在机动车道内行驶，车顶突然撞上举高车的工作斗，致正在为天桥涂刷油漆的工人跌落在公交车车顶被困。
articles.summary: 中新网报道，9月19日下午山西晋中一辆公交车在机动车道行驶时，车顶撞上举高车的工作斗，导致正在为天桥涂刷油漆的工人跌落到公交车车顶并被困。当地消防救援人员采用拉梯担架一体转运技术，将受伤男子从车顶转运至地面。事件直观反映出道路通行空间与高空作业区域重叠时的安全风险，以及救援装备与技术在处置此类被困场景中的作用。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这不是AI应用项目，而是一起城市高空作业与道路通行交叉导致的事故；关键提示是作业区与行车道未有效隔离时，风险会直接叠加到路过的车辆与工人身上。

articles.title: The Coziest Place on the Moon: Or, How to Bear Your Loneliness
articles.highlight: 2022年7月26日，我正经历强烈孤独；NASA称月球上的圆柱形坑洞恰能遮蔽极端温度。
articles.summary: 这篇文章从作者2022年7月26日的强烈孤独体验写起，转向NASA月球勘测轨道器的建模发现：月球上有些圆柱形坑洞因形状和阴影恰到好处，能避开月球表面的极端温度。月球没有大气充当恒温器，温度会在白天升至约127°C，又在夜晚骤降，这让坑洞的遮蔽意义格外鲜明。文章值得读，在于它把天文发现与孤独体验并置，提供一种意象式的安慰与思考。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键不在于消除孤独，而在于像月球坑洞那样，找到刚好能遮蔽极端处境的一小块阴影。它提醒人先寻求可栖身的环境，而不是硬扛一切。

en.highlight: On July 26, 2022, as I lived through acute loneliness, NASA reported that lunar pits with just the right shape could offer shelter from the Moon's extremes.
en.summary: This Marginalian article opens with the author's acute loneliness on July 26, 2022, then turns to NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter modeling of cylindrical pits on the Moon that offer shade from extreme surface temperatures. articles.sourceExcerpt: Extreme-Scale Linear-Scaling Kohn-Sham DFT at 100 Million Atoms: Bridging Quantum Simulations and Experiments Qimen Xu 1,*,†, Yu Zhang 1,*, Dixing Ni 1, Lei Gao 2, Guangnan Feng 3, Qinrui Zheng 1, Jianting Liu 1 Haitian Lu 4, Zhaopeng Jia 5, Wei Xue 5, Shriram Chandran 6, Torsten Hoefler6,7,†, Haohuan Fu 1,8,†, Yutong Lu 1,3,† 1National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China 2Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School, Guangdong, China 3Sun Yat-sen University, Guangdong, China 4National Supercomputing Center in Wuxi, Jiangsu, China 5Tsinghua University, Beijing, China 6ETH Zurich, Zurich, Switzerland 7ADIA Lab Fellow 8Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Guangdong, China *These authors contributed equally to this work. †Corresponding authors: xuqm@nsccsz.cn; torsten.hoefler@inf.ethz.ch; haohuan@tsinghua.edu.cn; luyutong@mail.sysu.edu.cn Abstract Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) remains the workhorse ofab initiomaterials simulation, yet cubic com- putational and quadratic memory scaling have confined cal- culations to a few hundred to thousands of atoms, spanning only nanometers, far below experimentally relevant length scales. We introduce XLSDFT, a linear-scaling DFT frame- work based on divide-and-conquer decomposition of the one- particle density matrix and Chebyshev-filtered subspace itera- tion, achieving linear computational and memory scaling while retaining DFT accuracy.

articles.title: Why I still haven’t bought into true RSI
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 文章以“AI温和派”的视角讨论近期事件，以及前沿模型的可能走向。作者解释自己为何仍未接受“真正的RSI”（递归式自我改进）这一叙事。它值得读，因为它呈现了对模型能力跃迁、自动改进与风险判断的一种审慎立场。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点：讨论RSI时，要区分模型能力提升与真正可自我加速的闭环。判断前沿模型轨迹，需要同时看证据、时间尺度与安全边界。

en.highlight: An AI moderate’s view on recent events and the trajectory of frontier models, and why true RSI still fails to convince.
en.summary: The article presents an AI moderate’s perspective on recent developments and the likely path of frontier models. It explains why the author remains skeptical of the “true RSI” narrative. It is worth reading for a cautious view on capability jumps, automated improvement, and risk judgments.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is to separate incremental model progress from a genuine self-improving loop. Judging frontier-model trajectories requires evidence, time horizons, and safety boundaries.
